title: Ex-soldier, cop nabbed over alleged illegal firearms sale in Pangasinan

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—A former soldier and an active police officer were arrested in Pangasinan for allegedly trading firearms, the Philippine National Police (PNP) and Criminal Investigation and Detection Group (CIDG) said on Wednesday. The CIDG Pangasinan Provincial Field Unit, along with the Integrity Monitoring and Enforcement Group (IMEG) Luzon Field Unit and the Villasis Municipal Police Station, conducted the operation at 1:35 p.m. on Tuesday in Barangay Puelay. The CIDG said one suspect was a former Philippine Army member, while the other was an active noncommissioned officer of the PNP.
